continuous_elo.history_note: Latest 5,000 recorded points per version and contract. Older points are saved dashboard snapshots, not per-game history. New points record each seat-pair update; time is processing time, so batches share a timestamp. The average requires 50 consecutive paired updates / 100 games. Full history stays stored on the server.
continuous_elo.method: Internal Elo, not a replica of Kaggle live ratings. Start 1500; K=32 per completed seat-swapped pair; draws half a point; separate table per execution contract

mini.scheduling: daily tournament first; continuous resumes when assigned daily games finish

vast.scheduling: daily tournament first; continuous resumes when assigned daily games finish
